headline: `diagnose` subcommand + conflict copies + parallel uploads + systemd notify

items.title: `hermitstash-sync diagnose` subcommand
items.body: Runs a one-shot health pass against the configured server: pubkey fetch, mTLS handshake check, bundle metadata round-trip, websocket connect + heartbeat, clock drift vs server time. Prints a structured report and a non-zero exit code on any failed check, suitable for use as a readiness probe.

items.title: Conflict copies on last-write-wins overwrite
items.body: When the last-write-wins resolver overwrites a local edit, the previous local copy is preserved as `<filename>.conflict-<timestamp>` in the same directory rather than being silently lost. The operator can recover or re-merge from the conflict copy at their leisure.

items.title: Parallel upload pool
items.body: Upload concurrency is now configurable via `config.json#uploadConcurrency` (default `4`). Multiple file uploads run in parallel against the server instead of serially, which materially improves first-sync wall-clock time on bundles with many small files.

items.title: `sd_notify`-style systemd readiness signaling
items.body: When launched under systemd with `NOTIFY_SOCKET` set, the daemon now emits `READY=1` after the initial handshake + first-sync completes, and periodic `WATCHDOG=1` heartbeats inside the configured `WatchdogSec` window. `Type=notify` units now report `active (running)` only after the daemon is genuinely ready to handle changes.

items.title: README requirements line updated for blamejs v0.10.6
items.body: The README's runtime-requirements section now lists the vendored blamejs version that v0.8.1 bumped to. Operators reading the README to verify their build no longer see a stale v0.9.54 number.
